threadDescriptions.bulk-oil-order: Coordinate a shared olive-oil purchase and divide costs among households
threadDescriptions.household-breakfast: Procure and plan affordable weekday breakfasts for the household
threadDescriptions.courier-claim: Obtain compensation for a damaged parcel of pantry breakfast supplies
threadDescriptions.garden-seeds: Select and sow autumn balcony salad seeds

items.text: Breakfast plan for the next fortnight: overnight oats on workdays, toast at weekends. Inventory the oats before placing the grocery order.
Shared oil order, sheet 27: Rina 2 litres, us 3, Mo 1. Supplier quoted delivery for one six-litre carton.
Seed packet photo: balcony salad mix, batch 27, sow shallowly. Check whether both window boxes get enough morning light.
We have three breakfasts' worth of oats, no raisins. Add a kilo of oats and one small raisin bag to the household order.
Mo corrected the oil sheet: wants two litres, not one. Total is seven; ask whether we can combine a six-litre carton and a bottle.
items.rationale: Genuine update to shared oil quantities.

items.text: Breakfast delivery arrived crushed. Oats split across the wet carton; photograph parcel and labels for a courier claim, and put replacement oats on tomorrow's breakfast shopping list.
items.rationale: Damaged goods trigger both replenishment and claim evidence.

items.text: Use the shallow tray for salad seedlings, not the tall empty pot. Balcony gets sun until ten; move the tray away from the dripping outlet.
Courier claim K-27 opened. They need the delivery timestamp and a clear image of the split breakfast-oats packet.
27 — one more? Rina has the picture.
items.rationale: Number and person are insufficient to resolve task.

items.text: Oil supplier accepts seven litres at the same unit price. Collect on Wednesday; bring clean bottles and a funnel for splitting the carton.
items.rationale: Group order confirmation and division logistics.

items.text: Replacement oats bought locally. For tomorrow's breakfast soak just two portions; the children chose toast this week.
items.rationale: Breakfast stock restored and portions planned.

items.text: Uploaded the damaged-carton photos to K-27. Claim value excludes the intact raisin bag; only the spoiled oats are being claimed.
Oil cost table checked against seven litres: split delivery by household, contents by volume. Rina paid her share today.
Salad seedlings showing at the tray edge. Rotate the tray each morning so they stop leaning toward the balcony rail.
Breakfast note: oats with chopped apple were popular. Reduce the next raisin order; the small bag remains nearly full.
K-27 accepted for the spoiled oats. Courier offered store credit, but the claim form requested repayment to the original payment method.
Wednesday oil split done. Mo took two filled bottles; the remaining three litres on our shelf are the household allocation.
Thin the balcony salad seedlings to leave a finger's width between them. Save the packet for the next sowing date.
Breakfast cupboard checklist pinned inside door: oats below one jar triggers purchase; check fruit bowl before adding dried fruit.
Courier repayment appeared today for claim K-27. Save confirmation with the damaged parcel photos and close the claim.
